claims.statement: Joe Goss, from New York, challenged Tom Allen, now of St. Louis, to a fight.

claims.statement: Goss's challenge proposed a fight four months after signing articles.
claims.excerpt: the tight to take place four months from the date of signing articles

claims.statement: Goss had reportedly deposited $500 with Eph Holland to make a match with Allen, a claim the paper doubted.
claims.excerpt: deposited $500 with Eph Holland, to make a match with Allen

claims.statement: Tom Allen telegraphed Joe Goss that he would meet him in Cincinnati on 12 May 1876 to draw up articles for a fight.
claims.excerpt: has telegraphed Joe Goss that he will meet him in Cincinnati, May 12th,to drawup articles

quotes.speaker: Joe Goss
quotes.text: I mean business, and am ready to put up at any time the necessary forfeit.

notes: Challenge only; no bout was agreed in this text. Goss's circus travel and title claim concern Goss, not Allen, and were not extracted.
